items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Robert E. Lee, a fine, fine guitar player and writer. ... I heard Robert E. Lee wrote it on 'Indian Love Call' for the band one time, Don Dunbar's band

ctx.x: was writing at the time, and maybe his name will come to me... Robert E. Lee, that's his name. Robert E. Lee, a fine, fine guitar player and writer. So they had a lot of arrangements, you know...
